newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Unifi shrs continue to rise.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Unifi shrs continue to rise.

text.p: Shares in textile company Unifi Inc continued to climb after hours on Wednesday, rising 1/2 to a new 52-week high of 29-5/8, traders said.
Unifi, based in Greensboro, N.C., had gained 7/8 during regular market hours to reach a high of 29-1/8.
The company said on Wednesday it plans a Dutch auction tender offer for between four million and six million shares of common stock.
Shares in two major insurance companies, CIGNA Corp and Life Re, did not move after hours despite the release of third-quarter earnings, traders said.

CIGNA posted third-quarter operating net income of $3.55 per share compared with a loss of $7.94 a year earlier. Life Re reported third-quarter net income of $0.76 per share compared with $0.61 per share a year earlier.
The New York Stock Exchange said there was no session one volume, compared with Tuesday's volume of 37,000 shares. Session two volume was 926,900 shares compared with 2,777,400 shares on Tuesday.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
